compatibilityIssues: Migration from Web Forms to .NET 8 required
upgradeSteps: Refactor Web Forms to Razor Pages/MVC

issues.impact: All database operations must be rewritten. EF6 DbContext needs migration to EF Core DbContext. Entity configurations, migrations, and query syntax differ significantly.
issues.description: EntityFramework 6.2.0 is not compatible with .NET 8. EF6 is a legacy .NET Framework-only package that does not support .NET Core/.NET 8. All data access code must be migrated to Entity Framework Core 8.0.0.
issues.recommendation: Replace EntityFramework 6.2.0 with Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore 8.0.0 and Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.SqlServer 8.0.0. Migrate DbContext configuration from EntityTypeConfiguration to IEntityTypeConfiguration<T>. Update all LINQ queries for EF Core compatibility. Replace Database.SqlQuery with FromSqlRaw/FromSqlInterpolated.
issues.title: Entity Framework 6.2.0 - Not Compatible with .NET 8

issues.impact: All logging statements must be updated. LogManager.GetLogger() calls must be replaced with ILogger<T> dependency injection. Log configuration migrates from XML to code-based configuration.
issues.description: log4net is a legacy logging framework not recommended for .NET 8. Modern .NET uses Microsoft.Extensions.Logging with structured logging support.
issues.recommendation: Replace log4net with Microsoft.Extensions.Logging 8.0.0 and Serilog.AspNetCore 8.0.0. Replace all ILog instances with ILogger<T>. Remove log4Net.xml configuration and configure logging in Program.cs. Update all logging statements to use structured logging patterns.
issues.title: log4net 2.0.10 - Legacy Logging Framework

issues.impact: Core framework change affecting all pages. Every .aspx page must be migrated to Razor Pages (.cshtml). All code-behind logic must be rewritten as PageModel handlers.
issues.description: System.Web assembly is .NET Framework-only and not available in .NET 8. All System.Web dependencies must be replaced with ASP.NET Core equivalents.
issues.recommendation: Replace all System.Web usage with ASP.NET Core equivalents: HttpContext.Current → IHttpContextAccessor, Page → PageModel, Server.MapPath → IWebHostEnvironment.WebRootPath, Session → TempData/DistributedCache, Cache → IMemoryCache/IDistributedCache.
issues.title: System.Web Reference - Not Available in .NET 8

issues.impact: Application initialization and request pipeline must be completely restructured. Autofac container setup needs migration to built-in DI. Session tracking logic needs redesign.
issues.description: Global.asax is a Web Forms application lifecycle file not supported in ASP.NET Core. Application_Start, Session_Start, and Application_BeginRequest events need migration to middleware and Program.cs.
issues.recommendation: Migrate Global.asax logic to Program.cs. Application_Start → Program.cs startup configuration. Session_Start → Session middleware configuration. Application_BeginRequest → Custom middleware. Move routing configuration to endpoint routing in Program.cs.
issues.title: Global.asax Application Events

issues.impact: All static HttpContext.Current calls must be replaced with dependency injection. Session access pattern changes from Session[key] to HttpContext.Session.GetString(key)/SetString(key).
issues.description: HttpContext.Current static accessor is not available in ASP.NET Core. Found in multiple locations accessing Session and Request.
issues.recommendation: Replace HttpContext.Current with IHttpContextAccessor service. Inject IHttpContextAccessor into services/middleware that need access to HttpContext. Use httpContextAccessor.HttpContext instead of HttpContext.Current.
issues.title: HttpContext.Current Usage

issues.impact: All configuration access changes from ConfigurationManager to IConfiguration. Connection strings accessed via IConfiguration["ConnectionStrings:CatalogDBContext"]. HTTP modules and handlers become middleware.
issues.description: Web.config is Web Forms-specific and not used in ASP.NET Core. Configuration must migrate to appsettings.json with IConfiguration.
issues.recommendation: Create appsettings.json and appsettings.Development.json. Migrate connectionStrings, appSettings, and system.web configurations. Use IConfiguration and Options pattern for accessing settings. Configure services in Program.cs instead of Web.config.
issues.title: Web.config Configuration File

issues.impact: Entire dependency injection setup must be rewritten. ContainerDisposal and PropertyInjection HTTP modules must be replaced with scoped service pattern. All property injection needs to become constructor injection.
issues.description: Autofac.Integration.Web is designed for Web Forms and not compatible with ASP.NET Core. ASP.NET Core has built-in DI container.
issues.recommendation: Remove Autofac.Integration.Web. Consider using built-in ASP.NET Core DI or migrate to Autofac.Extensions.DependencyInjection 8.0.0 if Autofac features are required. Migrate IContainerProviderAccessor pattern to standard DI registration in Program.cs.
issues.title: Autofac.Integration.Web 4.0.0 - Web Forms Specific

issues.codeSnippet: <%@ Page Title="Home Page" Language="C#" MasterPageFile="~/Site.Master" AutoEventWireup="true" CodeBehind="Default.aspx.cs" Inherits="eShopLegacyWebForms._Default" %>
issues.impact: Complete page rewrite required. Master page becomes _Layout.cshtml. Server controls become HTML elements. Code-behind becomes PageModel class. Page lifecycle events become handler methods.
issues.description: .aspx pages with code-behind are Web Forms-specific and must be migrated to Razor Pages or MVC. Default.aspx contains ListView server controls, master pages, and page lifecycle events.
issues.recommendation: Migrate to Razor Pages Index.cshtml with PageModel. Replace ListView with HTML table and Razor foreach loop. Replace GetRouteUrl with asp-route tag helpers. Move Page_Load logic to OnGet/OnGetAsync handler. Replace server controls with HTML + Tag Helpers.
issues.title: ASP.NET Web Forms Pages - Default.aspx

issues.impact: Layout system completely changes. ScriptManager functionality must be replaced with standard HTML script tags. Server-side controls in master page must become client-side HTML.
issues.description: Master pages (.master files) are Web Forms-specific layout mechanism. ASP.NET Core uses Layout pages (_Layout.cshtml).
issues.recommendation: Migrate Site.Master to Pages/Shared/_Layout.cshtml. Replace ContentPlaceHolder with @RenderBody(). Replace asp:ScriptManager with standard script tags. Remove runat="server" from HTML elements. Move Session access from code-behind to ViewData/TempData.
issues.title: Master Pages - Site.Master

issues.impact: User control logic must be refactored. Event handlers become methods in PageModel or controller. State management changes from ViewState to model binding.
issues.description: User controls (.ascx) are Web Forms components that must be migrated to Partial Views or View Components.
issues.recommendation: Migrate ViewSwitcher.ascx to a Partial View (_ViewSwitcher.cshtml) or View Component. Replace code-behind logic with Tag Helper or view component logic. Use @await Html.PartialAsync() or <vc:view-switcher /> to render.
issues.title: User Control - ViewSwitcher.ascx

issues.impact: Complete form handling rewrite. Server controls → HTML inputs. Postback events → POST handler methods. Validation controls → Data annotations and FluentValidation.
issues.description: Web Forms CRUD page with server controls (TextBox, DropDownList, RequiredFieldValidator, Button) and postback event handlers.
issues.recommendation: Migrate to Razor Pages Create.cshtml with [BindProperty] for model binding. Replace server controls with HTML inputs and asp- tag helpers. Replace Create_Click with OnPost/OnPostAsync handler. Replace ModelState.IsValid with PageModel validation. Replace Response.Redirect with RedirectToPage.
issues.title: CRUD Pages - Create.aspx

issues.codeSnippet:
<asp:TextBox ID="Name" runat="server" CssClass="form-control" Text='<%#product.Name%>'></asp:TextBox>
<asp:RequiredFieldValidator runat="server" ControlToValidate="Name" ... />
issues.impact: Data binding syntax completely changes. Server-side validation controls become client-side validation via tag helpers and data annotations. Button click events become form POST handlers.
issues.description: Edit page uses Web Forms data binding syntax (<%# %>) and server controls with validation.
issues.recommendation: Migrate to Razor Pages Edit.cshtml. Replace <%# %> binding with Razor @Model syntax. Replace server controls with HTML inputs and asp-for tag helpers. Replace RequiredFieldValidator with data annotations [Required]. Replace Save_Click with OnPostAsync handler.
issues.title: CRUD Pages - Edit.aspx with Data Binding

issues.impact: DbContext must be completely rewritten for EF Core. Entity configurations use different syntax. Database initialization strategy changes to migrations. Connection string configuration moves to Program.cs.
issues.description: CatalogDBContext uses EF6 EntityTypeConfiguration which is incompatible with EF Core. Configuration methods differ significantly.
issues.recommendation: Migrate to EF Core DbContext. Replace DbModelBuilder with ModelBuilder. Replace EntityTypeConfiguration<T> with IEntityTypeConfiguration<T>. Update constructor to accept DbContextOptions<CatalogDBContext>. Replace HasRequired/WithMany with HasOne/WithMany. Update entity configuration syntax.
issues.title: Entity Framework 6 DbContext Configuration

issues.codeSnippet:
var itemsOnPage = db.CatalogItems
    .Include(c => c.CatalogBrand)
    .Include(c => c.CatalogType)
    .OrderBy(c => c.Id)
    .Skip(pageSize * pageIndex)
    .Take(pageSize)
    .ToList();
issues.impact: All service methods become async. All page handlers must use async/await. Method signatures change throughout the application. Better scalability and performance in .NET 8.
issues.description: CatalogService uses synchronous EF methods (ToList, SaveChanges) which are not recommended in modern .NET.
issues.recommendation: Convert all database operations to async/await. Replace ToList() with ToListAsync(). Replace SaveChanges() with SaveChangesAsync(). Add CancellationToken parameters. Update method signatures to return Task<T>. Update all calling code to use await.
issues.title: Synchronous Database Operations

issues.impact: Session access pattern changes. Session values must be serialized as strings or bytes. Requires explicit session middleware configuration. May need distributed cache for multi-server scenarios.
issues.description: Application uses Session state for storing MachineName and SessionStartTime. ASP.NET Core session works differently and requires explicit configuration.
issues.recommendation: Configure session middleware in Program.cs with builder.Services.AddSession(). Use HttpContext.Session.SetString()/GetString() instead of indexer. Consider using distributed cache (Redis) for production. For simple scenarios, use TempData or ViewData instead of Session.
issues.title: Session State Usage

issues.impact: BundleConfig.cs must be removed or replaced. Script and style bundling requires new implementation. Can use WebOptimizer or modern JavaScript build tools.
issues.description: Web.Optimization package for bundling and minification is Web Forms-specific and not available in .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Remove Microsoft.AspNet.Web.Optimization. Use WebOptimizer package (LigerShark.WebOptimizer.Core 3.0.0) or build-time bundlers like webpack, gulp, or Vite. For simple scenarios, reference files directly with asp-append-version for cache busting.
issues.title: Microsoft.AspNet.Web.Optimization - Not Compatible

issues.impact: All AJAX functionality using UpdatePanel must be rewritten. Client script registration changes to standard HTML script tags. Partial page updates require JavaScript/htmx implementation.
issues.description: ScriptManager is a Web Forms control for managing client scripts and UpdatePanels. Not available in ASP.NET Core.
issues.recommendation: Remove ScriptManager packages. Replace ScriptManager with standard script tags in _Layout.cshtml. Replace UpdatePanel with partial page updates using JavaScript fetch API or libraries like htmx or Alpine.js. Use Tag Helpers for script management.
issues.title: Microsoft.AspNet.ScriptManager - Web Forms Specific

issues.impact: All route definitions must be migrated to ASP.NET Core routing. GetRouteUrl() calls become asp-route-* tag helpers. Friendly URLs become standard Razor Pages routing.
issues.description: RouteConfig.RegisterRoutes uses Web Forms routing which is different from ASP.NET Core routing.
issues.recommendation: Remove RouteConfig class. Configure routing in Program.cs using endpoint routing. For Razor Pages, use @page directive with route templates. For MVC, use attribute routing or conventional routing with MapControllerRoute().
issues.title: RouteConfig for Web Forms Routing

issues.impact: All page lifecycle code must be restructured. DataBind() calls removed (Razor handles binding automatically). IsPostBack checks become separate OnGet/OnPost handlers. Event sender/args pattern eliminated.
issues.description: Web Forms pages use Page_Load lifecycle events which don't exist in Razor Pages. Found in 12 code-behind files.
issues.recommendation: Replace Page_Load with OnGet/OnGetAsync handler in PageModel. Replace Page_Init with constructor or OnGetAsync. Remove EventArgs parameters. Use [BindProperty] for model binding instead of manual extraction. Return IActionResult instead of void.
issues.title: Page Lifecycle Events

issues.impact: All UI markup must be rewritten. Server control events become form POST handlers. ViewState eliminated (stateless by default). Client-side validation generated from data annotations.
issues.description: Application uses 86+ instances of runat="server" controls including ListView, DropDownList, TextBox, RequiredFieldValidator, RangeValidator, HyperLink, Button, Image, Label.
issues.recommendation: Replace all server controls with HTML elements and Tag Helpers: ListView → @foreach loop, DropDownList → <select asp-for asp-items>, TextBox → <input asp-for>, Validators → data annotations + asp-validation-for, Button → <button>, HyperLink → <a asp-page>.
issues.title: Server Controls - ListView, DropDownList, Button

issues.impact: URL patterns may change slightly. Mobile/desktop switching logic needs reimplementation if required. Most functionality is built into ASP.NET Core routing.
issues.description: FriendlyUrls package provides Web Forms-specific URL routing features not applicable to ASP.NET Core.
issues.recommendation: Remove Microsoft.AspNet.FriendlyUrls package. ASP.NET Core has built-in clean URL routing. Use Razor Pages @page directive for route templates. Use route constraints for parameters. Configure lowercase URLs in Program.cs with RouteOptions.
issues.title: Microsoft.AspNet.FriendlyUrls - Web Forms Feature

issues.impact: All redirect calls must return IActionResult. Tilde (~) path resolution handled by RedirectToPage/RedirectToAction. Better security with built-in open redirect protection.
issues.description: Code uses Response.Redirect for navigation which needs to be replaced with Razor Pages redirect methods.
issues.recommendation: Replace Response.Redirect with return RedirectToPage(). Use RedirectToPage("./Index") for local redirects. Use RedirectToAction() if using MVC. Use LocalRedirect() for user-supplied URLs to prevent open redirect vulnerabilities.
issues.title: Response.Redirect Usage

issues.impact: Database initialization strategy changes to migrations. Seed data can be applied via HasData() or DbContext initialization. No automatic recreation of database on model changes.
issues.description: Uses Database.SetInitializer for seeding data which is deprecated in EF Core.
issues.recommendation: Remove Database.SetInitializer. Use EF Core migrations for schema creation. Implement data seeding in Program.cs using EF Core HasData() in entity configuration or manual seeding after context creation. Use IHostedService for startup data initialization if needed.
issues.title: Database Initializer Pattern

issues.impact: All configuration access must use IConfiguration. Settings move from Web.config to appsettings.json. Type-safe access available via Options pattern.
issues.description: Application uses ConfigurationManager.AppSettings for reading configuration which is .NET Framework pattern.
issues.recommendation: Replace ConfigurationManager with IConfiguration. Inject IConfiguration into services. Access settings via configuration["UseMockData"] or use Options pattern with IOptions<T>. Create strongly-typed configuration classes with [Bind] attribute.
issues.title: ConfigurationManager Usage

issues.impact: All pages/services must add constructors. Properties become constructor parameters. Better dependency tracking and testability. No need for property injection HTTP module.
issues.description: Application uses property injection for services (public ICatalogService CatalogService { get; set; }) which is discouraged in .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Replace property injection with constructor injection in PageModel classes. Add constructor with service parameters. Store services as private readonly fields. Built-in DI container supports constructor injection by default.
issues.title: Property Injection Pattern

issues.impact: Model access pattern changes. Code-behind Model property becomes PageModel class itself. View accesses data via @Model.PropertyName.
issues.description: Code-behind uses protected Model property which doesn't exist in Razor Pages PageModel.
issues.recommendation: In PageModel, Model property is built-in and represents the page model itself. Move Model to be a property of the PageModel class. Access in Razor view as @Model. Use [BindProperty] for properties that should be bound on POST.
issues.title: Model Property in Code-Behind

issues.impact: Telemetry configuration moves to Program.cs. ApplicationInsights.config replaced with appsettings.json. HTTP modules replaced with middleware. SDK initialization different.
issues.description: Application Insights version 2.9.1 is outdated. Modern .NET 8 uses Application Insights 2.22.0+.
issues.recommendation: Update to Microsoft.ApplicationInsights.AspNetCore 2.22.0 for ASP.NET Core. Remove Web-specific Application Insights packages. Configure in Program.cs with builder.Services.AddApplicationInsightsTelemetry(). Remove ApplicationInsights.config and use appsettings.json for configuration.
issues.title: Microsoft.ApplicationInsights 2.9.1 - Outdated Version

issues.impact: System.Text.Json has different API and defaults. May require code changes if using advanced Json.NET features. Better performance with System.Text.Json.
issues.description: Application uses Newtonsoft.Json 12.0.1. While compatible, .NET 8 prefers System.Text.Json for better performance.
issues.recommendation: Consider migrating to System.Text.Json (built-in to .NET 8) for better performance and smaller footprint. If Newtonsoft.Json features are required, update to latest version 13.0.3. Review JSON serialization/deserialization code for compatibility.
issues.title: Newtonsoft.Json 12.0.1 - Use System.Text.Json

issues.impact: Modern distributed tracing with OpenTelemetry. Better integration with Application Insights. Remove log4net LogicalThreadContext dependency.
issues.description: Application uses Trace.CorrelationManager for activity tracking which is legacy pattern.
issues.recommendation: Replace with Activity from System.Diagnostics or use built-in ASP.NET Core request tracking. Use HttpContext.TraceIdentifier for request correlation. Integrate with Application Insights or OpenTelemetry for distributed tracing.
issues.title: Trace.CorrelationManager Usage

issues.impact: Much simpler project files. Automatic file inclusion. PackageReference instead of packages.config. Faster build times. Better tooling support.
issues.description: Project uses old .NET Framework csproj format with verbose XML. Modern .NET uses SDK-style projects.
issues.recommendation: Convert to SDK-style csproj: <Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web">. Remove verbose item includes (files included by default). Use PackageReference instead of packages.config. Set TargetFramework to net8.0. Remove unnecessary MSBuild imports.
issues.title: Old Project Format - Not SDK-Style

issues.impact: Module configuration moves from Web.config to code. Middleware order matters (specify in Program.cs). Better control over request pipeline. Async support in middleware.
issues.description: Web.config configures HTTP modules (Autofac, TelemetryCorrelation, ApplicationInsights) which must become middleware.
issues.recommendation: Replace HTTP modules with middleware in Program.cs. ContainerDisposal → automatic with scoped DI. PropertyInjection → constructor injection. TelemetryCorrelation → built-in with Application Insights. Configure middleware pipeline with app.Use*() methods.
issues.title: HTTP Modules Configuration

issues.impact: All relationship configurations must be updated. Syntax more explicit in EF Core. Better separation with IEntityTypeConfiguration<T> classes.
issues.description: Entity configuration uses HasRequired/WithMany which is EF6 syntax not available in EF Core.
issues.recommendation: Replace HasRequired with HasOne in EF Core. Replace WithMany() with WithMany(). Update to: builder.HasOne(ci => ci.CatalogBrand).WithMany().HasForeignKey(ci => ci.CatalogBrandId).IsRequired(). Move configurations to separate IEntityTypeConfiguration<T> classes.
issues.title: EF6 HasRequired/WithMany Syntax

issues.impact: Better separation of concerns. Configuration classes can be unit tested. Follows EF Core best practices. More maintainable code.
issues.description: Uses EntityTypeConfiguration<T> which is EF6 pattern. EF Core uses IEntityTypeConfiguration<T>.
issues.recommendation: Create separate configuration classes implementing IEntityTypeConfiguration<T>. Apply configurations using modelBuilder.ApplyConfiguration(new CatalogTypeConfiguration()). Move configuration methods out of DbContext into dedicated classes in Data/Configurations folder.
issues.title: EntityTypeConfiguration Class

issues.impact: Script and style bundling requires new approach. Can use asp-append-version for simple cache busting. WebOptimizer provides runtime bundling. Build tools provide better optimization.
issues.description: Application uses BundleConfig.RegisterBundles for Web Forms bundling which must be replaced.
issues.recommendation: Remove BundleConfig. Use WebOptimizer package or reference files individually with asp-append-version="true" for cache busting. For production, use build tools like webpack or Vite. Configure bundling in Program.cs if using WebOptimizer.
issues.title: BundleConfig for Script/Style Bundling

issues.impact: Straightforward migration. Mostly markup changes. Minimal logic to migrate.
issues.description: Static content page that needs migration to Razor Page.
issues.recommendation: Migrate to Pages/About.cshtml. Simple content page with minimal logic. Replace master page reference with Layout directive. Remove code-behind if only contains Page_Load with no logic.
issues.title: About.aspx Page

issues.impact: Simple migration with mostly static content.
issues.description: Static content page that needs migration to Razor Page.
issues.recommendation: Migrate to Pages/Contact.cshtml. Simple content page. Replace master page with Layout. Remove code-behind if empty.
issues.title: Contact.aspx Page

issues.impact: Simple read-only page. Straightforward migration to Razor Pages.
issues.description: Read-only display page with server controls.
issues.recommendation: Migrate to Pages/Catalog/Details.cshtml. Replace server controls with HTML and Razor syntax. Load data in OnGetAsync(int id). Display using @Model.Property. Add validation for id parameter.
issues.title: Details.aspx CRUD Page

issues.impact: Standard CRUD delete page. Follow Razor Pages conventions.
issues.description: Delete confirmation page with GET display and POST delete.
issues.recommendation: Migrate to Pages/Catalog/Delete.cshtml. OnGet loads item for confirmation. OnPost performs delete. Use [ValidateAntiForgeryToken] attribute. Return RedirectToPage("./Index") after delete. Show confirmation message using TempData.
issues.title: Delete.aspx CRUD Page

issues.impact: May not need feature detection for modern browser targets. CSS @supports is built-in. Reduces JavaScript dependencies.
issues.description: Modernizr 2.8.3 is outdated. Modern browsers have good feature support and CSS feature queries.
issues.recommendation: Consider removing Modernizr if targeting modern browsers. Use CSS @supports for feature detection. If needed, update to Modernizr 3.x or use more modern feature detection approaches. Review which features actually need detection.
issues.title: Modernizr 2.8.3 - Legacy Feature Detection

issues.impact: Removed with Web.Optimization. No replacement needed.
issues.description: WebGrease is used by Web.Optimization and not needed in ASP.NET Core.
issues.recommendation: Remove WebGrease package when removing Web.Optimization. Not needed with modern bundling approaches.
issues.title: WebGrease 1.6.0 - Bundling Dependency

issues.impact: Removed with Web.Optimization. No replacement needed.
issues.description: Antlr is a dependency of Web.Optimization and not needed in ASP.NET Core.
issues.recommendation: Remove Antlr package when removing Web.Optimization.
issues.title: Antlr 3.5.0.2 - Bundling Dependency

issues.impact: Simpler maintenance with single responsive layout. Better user experience. No device detection needed.
issues.description: Separate mobile master page. Modern approach uses responsive design.
issues.recommendation: Consolidate into single _Layout.cshtml with responsive CSS (Bootstrap). Remove device detection logic. Use CSS media queries for mobile adaptations. Modern best practice is responsive design over separate mobile templates.
issues.title: Site.Mobile.Master - Mobile-Specific Layout

issues.codeSnippet: public PaginatedItemsViewModel<CatalogItem> GetCatalogItemsPaginated(int pageSize, int pageIndex)
issues.impact: Better scalability and performance. All calling code must use await. Async is the standard in modern .NET. Non-blocking I/O operations.
issues.description: Application doesn't use async/await patterns. Modern .NET strongly recommends async for I/O operations.
issues.recommendation: Convert all database and I/O operations to async. Add async/await throughout service layer. Update method signatures to return Task<T>. Add CancellationToken parameters. Update page handlers to OnGetAsync/OnPostAsync. Use ToListAsync, SaveChangesAsync, etc.
issues.title: Missing Async/Await Throughout

issues.impact: Better testability. Structured logging. Consistent logging framework. Easy to swap logging providers.
issues.description: Logging uses static LogManager.GetLogger() instead of dependency injection.
issues.recommendation: Inject ILogger<T> via constructor in all services and PageModels. Remove static logger fields. Use structured logging with message templates. Configure logging in Program.cs. Example: constructor(ILogger<IndexModel> logger) { _logger = logger; }
issues.title: No Dependency Injection for Logging

issues.codeSnippet: PaginationNext.NavigateUrl = GetRouteUrl("ProductsByPageRoute", new { index = Model.ActualPage + 1, size = Model.ItemsPerPage });
issues.impact: URL generation moves to tag helpers or Url.Page(). More type-safe with compile-time checking. Better IntelliSense support.
issues.description: Code uses GetRouteUrl() for generating URLs which is Web Forms pattern.
issues.recommendation: Replace GetRouteUrl with Url.Page() in PageModel or asp-page tag helper in Razor. Example: Url.Page("./Index", new { index = page, size = pageSize }) or <a asp-page="./Index" asp-route-index="@page">.
issues.title: GetRouteUrl() Method Calls

issues.impact: Better IntelliSense and compile-time checking in Razor. Cleaner syntax. No ItemPlaceholder or LayoutTemplate needed.
issues.description: Server controls use ItemType for strongly-typed data binding.
issues.recommendation: In Razor Pages, use @model directive at top of page for strongly-typed view. Use @foreach loop for collections. Type safety built-in with Razor syntax. Example: @model IndexModel, then @foreach(var item in Model.Items).
issues.title: ItemType Attribute on Server Controls

issues.impact: Better architecture and testability. Follows clean architecture principles. Easier to unit test services. Clear separation of data access.
issues.description: CatalogService directly uses DbContext instead of repository pattern.
issues.recommendation: Implement repository pattern with interfaces in Domain layer. Create repository implementations in Infrastructure layer. Inject repositories into services. Follow clean architecture: Domain → Application (Services) → Infrastructure (Repositories) → Web. Better testability and separation of concerns.
issues.title: No Repository Pattern

issues.impact: Better separation of concerns. Domain model protected from UI coupling. Can evolve domain and UI independently. Cleaner architecture.
issues.description: Application exposes domain entities directly to UI layer instead of using DTOs.
issues.recommendation: Create DTOs in Application layer for data transfer. Map entities to DTOs using AutoMapper or manual mapping. Create ViewModels in Web layer specific to UI needs. Separate domain entities from API/UI contracts. Protects domain model from UI changes.
issues.title: No DTOs - Using Entities Directly

issues.impact: Better security with automatic XSS protection. Built-in CSRF protection. Use data annotations for validation rules.
issues.description: Edit.aspx disables request validation which could allow XSS attacks.
issues.recommendation: Remove ValidateRequest="false". Enable proper input validation. Use data annotations for validation. ASP.NET Core has built-in XSS protection with automatic HTML encoding. Use asp-validation-* tag helpers. Validate and sanitize all user input.
issues.title: ValidateRequest=false on Edit Page

issues.impact: Better user experience with custom error pages. Centralized error logging. Consistent error responses. Security by hiding sensitive error details.
issues.description: Application lacks centralized exception handling.
issues.recommendation: Implement exception handling middleware in Program.cs. Use app.UseExceptionHandler() for production and app.UseDeveloperExceptionPage() for development. Create custom error pages. Log exceptions centrally. Return appropriate HTTP status codes.
issues.title: No Exception Handling Middleware

issues.impact: Better production monitoring. Kubernetes/container orchestration support. Early detection of issues.
issues.description: Application lacks health check endpoints for monitoring.
issues.recommendation: Implement health checks in .NET 8 application. Add builder.Services.AddHealthChecks() and configure database health checks. Map health check endpoint with app.MapHealthChecks("/health"). Monitor database connectivity and critical dependencies.
issues.title: No Health Checks

issues.impact: Better API documentation. Interactive API testing. Client code generation support.
issues.description: If exposing APIs, no Swagger/OpenAPI documentation.
issues.recommendation: If adding API endpoints, add Swashbuckle.AspNetCore package. Configure Swagger in Program.cs with builder.Services.AddSwaggerGen(). Add XML documentation comments. Expose Swagger UI for API exploration.
issues.title: No API Documentation

issues.impact: Better performance for cacheable content. Reduced server load. Improved response times.
issues.description: Application doesn't implement response caching for static or semi-static content.
issues.recommendation: Add response caching middleware with app.UseResponseCaching(). Add [ResponseCache] attributes to appropriate page models. Configure cache profiles in Program.cs. Use output caching for frequently accessed pages.
issues.title: No Response Caching

issues.impact: Reduced bandwidth usage. Faster page loads. Better mobile experience.
issues.description: Application doesn't compress responses.
issues.recommendation: Add response compression middleware with app.UseResponseCompression(). Configure compression providers (Gzip, Brotli). Reduces bandwidth usage and improves load times.
issues.title: No Response Compression

issues.impact: Better security. Encrypted traffic. Required for modern web applications.
issues.description: Application doesn't force HTTPS.
issues.recommendation: Add HTTPS redirection middleware with app.UseHttpsRedirection(). Configure HSTS with app.UseHsts() for production. Ensure all traffic uses HTTPS for security.
issues.title: No HTTPS Redirection

issues.impact: Better code quality. Easier refactoring. Catches regressions early. Documents expected behavior.
issues.description: No test projects found in solution.
issues.recommendation: Create test projects: ProjectName.UnitTests and ProjectName.IntegrationTests. Use xUnit, FluentAssertions, and Moq. Test services, validators, and repositories. Add integration tests for PageModels. Aim for 80%+ code coverage.
issues.title: No Unit Tests

issues.impact: Better data integrity. Clear validation rules. Reusable validators. Better user experience.
issues.description: Limited validation beyond server control validators.
issues.recommendation: Implement FluentValidation for complex validation rules. Use data annotations for simple validation. Create validator classes for each DTO/ViewModel. Integrate with model validation in PageModels. Provide clear validation error messages.
issues.title: No Data Validation Layer

issues.impact: Reusable pagination logic. Better architecture. Easier to test.
issues.description: Pagination logic is in service layer, should be in repository.
issues.recommendation: Move pagination to repository layer. Create reusable pagination extension methods. Return PagedList<T> with metadata. Implement IQueryable extensions for Skip/Take. Better separation of concerns.
issues.title: No Pagination Implementation in Repository

issues.impact: Simpler code with built-in ID generation. Better integration with EF Core. Async support.
issues.description: Uses custom HiLo ID generation which may not be necessary with EF Core.
issues.recommendation: Review if custom ID generation is needed. EF Core has built-in HiLo support with UseHiLo() extension. Consider using identity columns or sequences. If keeping custom generator, make it async and inject via DI.
issues.title: CatalogItemHiLoGenerator - Custom ID Generation

issues.impact: Cleaner code. Container manages lifetimes. No manual disposal needed. Prevents disposal errors.
issues.description: CatalogService implements IDisposable manually which is not needed with DI.
issues.recommendation: Remove IDisposable from services. DbContext lifetime managed by DI container. Register DbContext as scoped service. No manual disposal needed. Container handles cleanup automatically.
issues.title: IDisposable Implementation for Services

issues.impact: Better testing practices. More maintainable tests. Industry-standard mocking libraries.
issues.description: CatalogServiceMock for testing exists but should use proper testing patterns.
issues.recommendation: Use Moq or NSubstitute for creating test doubles. Remove mock service class. Create fakes or use in-memory database for integration tests. Follow AAA pattern (Arrange-Act-Assert). Use dependency injection in tests.
issues.title: Mock Service Implementation

issues.impact: Type-safe route parameters. No manual parsing. Better IntelliSense. Automatic validation.
issues.description: Uses RouteData.Values dictionary for route parameters.
issues.recommendation: In Razor Pages, use method parameters with [FromRoute] attribute or PageModel properties with [BindProperty(SupportsGet = true)]. More type-safe and cleaner. Example: public async Task OnGetAsync(int size, int index).
issues.title: RouteData.Values Access Pattern

issues.impact: Cleaner mapping code. Reduces boilerplate. Easy to maintain mappings. Better separation of concerns.
issues.description: Application uses entities directly, would benefit from AutoMapper for DTO mapping.
issues.recommendation: Install AutoMapper.Extensions.Microsoft.DependencyInjection. Create MappingProfile classes. Register with builder.Services.AddAutoMapper(). Map entities to DTOs in Application layer. Keeps Web layer clean.
issues.title: No AutoMapper Configuration

issues.impact: Better JavaScript development experience. Modern build tooling. Latest TypeScript features.
issues.description: Project has TypeScript configuration but unclear if TypeScript is used.
issues.recommendation: Review if TypeScript is needed. In modern .NET, consider using TypeScript with npm/webpack build process instead of MSBuild compilation. Update to latest TypeScript version if keeping. Configure tsconfig.json properly.
issues.title: TypeScript Configuration

issues.impact: Explicit static file configuration. Better control over caching. Move files to wwwroot folder.
issues.description: Web Forms has implicit static file serving, must be explicit in ASP.NET Core.
issues.recommendation: Add app.UseStaticFiles() in Program.cs. Configure wwwroot folder for static files. Move Content, Scripts, Images folders to wwwroot. Configure static file options for caching. Use asp-append-version for cache busting.
issues.title: Static File Configuration

issues.impact: Code-based configuration. Better for CI/CD. Environment-specific settings in appsettings.
issues.description: Application Insights configured via XML file instead of code.
issues.recommendation: Remove ApplicationInsights.config. Configure Application Insights in Program.cs with builder.Services.AddApplicationInsightsTelemetry(). Store instrumentation key in appsettings.json. Use ILogger for custom telemetry.
issues.title: ApplicationInsights.config File

issues.impact: Better security. User management. Role-based access control. Audit trails.
issues.description: Application appears to have no authentication or authorization.
issues.recommendation: Implement ASP.NET Core Identity if needed. Add authentication middleware with app.UseAuthentication() and app.UseAuthorization(). Use [Authorize] attributes on PageModels. Consider role-based or policy-based authorization. Protect sensitive operations.
issues.title: No Authentication/Authorization

recommendations: Migrate Entity Framework 6 to EF Core 8 first. This is the foundation for data access and blocks other migrations. Install Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore 8.0.0 packages, rewrite DbContext, update entity configurations, and migrate to EF Core migrations.
Replace log4net with Microsoft.Extensions.Logging or Serilog. Update all logging statements throughout the application. This enables modern structured logging and better integration with .NET 8.
Create new .NET 8 project structure with clean architecture layers: Domain, Application, Infrastructure, and Web. Use SDK-style project files. Set up proper dependency injection in Program.cs.

Migrate all 7 .aspx pages to Razor Pages. Start with simplest pages (About, Contact) then tackle CRUD pages (Default, Create, Edit, Details, Delete). Replace master pages with _Layout.cshtml. Replace server controls with HTML + Tag Helpers. Convert Page_Load to OnGet/OnGetAsync handlers.

Migrate Web.config to appsettings.json. Move connection strings, app settings, and system.web configurations. Replace ConfigurationManager with IConfiguration. Set up environment-specific configurations (Development, Production).

Migrate from Autofac Web Forms integration to ASP.NET Core built-in DI or Autofac.Extensions.DependencyInjection. Replace property injection with constructor injection. Remove HTTP modules for container disposal and property injection. Register all services in Program.cs.

Implement repository pattern with interfaces in Domain layer and implementations in Infrastructure layer. Convert all database operations to async/await. Add CancellationToken support. Implement proper error handling and logging.

Implement DTOs in Application layer and ViewModels in Web layer. Use AutoMapper for entity-to-DTO mapping. Manually map DTOs to ViewModels in PageModels. This separates concerns and protects domain model.

Replace server control validators with data annotations and FluentValidation. Add validation attributes to DTOs/ViewModels. Create validator classes for complex rules. Use asp-validation-* tag helpers in Razor views.

Set up middleware pipeline in Program.cs: exception handling, HTTPS redirection, HSTS, static files, routing, authentication, authorization, session (if needed), endpoint routing. Replace HTTP modules with middleware where applicable.

Move Content, Scripts, Images folders to wwwroot. Remove Web.Optimization bundling. Use asp-append-version for cache busting. Consider WebOptimizer for runtime bundling or webpack for build-time bundling. Update all references to static files.

Review session usage and migrate to appropriate .NET 8 patterns. Configure session middleware if needed. Use distributed cache (Redis) for production multi-server scenarios. Consider TempData for simple scenarios. Remove HttpContext.Current usage.

Create unit test and integration test projects. Use xUnit, FluentAssertions, and Moq. Test services, validators, and repositories. Add integration tests for Razor Pages using WebApplicationFactory. Aim for 80%+ code coverage.

Update Application Insights to Microsoft.ApplicationInsights.AspNetCore 2.22.0. Remove ApplicationInsights.config. Configure in Program.cs. Use ILogger for custom telemetry. Update HTTP modules to middleware.
Implement health check endpoints for database and critical dependencies. Add response caching and compression middleware. Set up proper exception handling pages. Configure HTTPS redirection and HSTS.

Enable HTTPS redirection and HSTS. Implement authentication and authorization if needed using ASP.NET Core Identity. Remove ValidateRequest=false and rely on built-in XSS protection. Use data protection APIs for sensitive data. Enable CSRF protection (enabled by default).

Create migration documentation including architecture diagrams, setup instructions, configuration guide, and deployment notes. Document breaking changes and migration patterns. Create README with build and run instructions.
